input.quote: 11.1 Immediately on termination Vendor shall discontinue all assistance and permanently delete Customer Data without offering an export or migration support.
input.rationale: Section 11 otherwise meets the playbook (11.2 gives 30-day return in a commonly used machine-readable format; 11.3 gives secure deletion with officer certification), but 11.1 is squarely our walk-away position: no transition assistance, no export, and immediate permanent deletion of Customer Data on termination. It also contradicts 11.2, 11.3 and 10.1's reference to an agreed transition period. Minimal fix is to replace 11.1 with up to six months of transition assistance at Vendor's then-current rates and to subordinate deletion to 11.2/11.3; 90 days is an acceptable fallback.

proposal.summary: Replace immediate cessation/deletion in 11.1 with up to six months of transition assistance at Vendor's then-current rates
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 11.1 as drafted requires Vendor to stop all assistance and delete Customer Data immediately, with no export, which is our walk-away position and contradicts Sections 11.2, 11.3 and 10.1. We have replaced it with up to six months of transition assistance at Vendor's then-current rates, preserving the existing data-return and certified-deletion mechanics; we can accept 90 days as a fallback.

ops.oldText: Immediately on termination Vendor shall discontinue all assistance and permanently delete Customer Data without offering an export or migration support.
ops.newText: Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Order Form for any reason, Vendor shall, at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance, including export and migration support, for up to six months after the effective date of expiry or termination, at Vendor's then-current rates. Vendor shall not delete Customer Data except in accordance with Sections 11.2 and 11.3.
